name: Kaushik Roy

fitReason: Strong established embodied-method match despite a broader circuits/neuromorphic lab identity: directed work combines RL quadruped locomotion, learned perception/planning, and an LLM-conditioned flight interface. Particularly relevant to resource-efficient robot intelligence rather than general-purpose VLA scaling.

physicalEvidence.summary: September 2026 GLAMDRING §IV-D actually deploys a PPO-trained CPG policy on an unmodified Unitree Go2, with zero payload and no learned-gait retuning. Search constraints deliberately target Go2-compatible geometry; only this limited hardware demonstration is verified, not fabricated novel bodies or a full robustness study. April 2025 Neuro-LIFT separately executes indoor Bebop2 flights around/through a moving ring. These are current directed Purdue-group experiments with official adviser/student corroboration, physical25.

unknowns: West Lafayette host, not Purdue Indianapolis or a namesake researcher. Official public contact: kaushik@purdue.edu.

GLAMDRING trains in IsaacLab/PhysX; high-payload, morphology-search and actuator-envelope comparisons remain simulation results. Actual Go2 test is deliberately constrained, zero-payload and limited in scope.

Neuro-LIFT fine-tunes Llama-3.2-3B as a maneuver-feasibility classifier; it is not an end-to-end VLA policy. The DVS and Jetson sit offboard on a tripod because of payload limits, with motion-capture compensation. Low-level control is PID; the TurtleBot moves the obstacle by teleoperation, not learned autonomous navigation.

Reuse Purdue feasibility anchor purdue: formal host invitation/approval and appointment are required. Degree-linked Student Intern and Short-Term Scholar have different eligibility; ISS chooses the applicable category. Personal/family support may count under the published funding rules, but does not create a lab place. No informal volunteering/tourist workaround.

Summer 2027 availability, eight-week scope, funding, remote participation, mentoring and robot access remain unknown. Historical visitor degrees/durations must not be converted into a current master’s invitation.
Public robot research does not confirm current equipment access, a summer 2027 offer or host availability.
